words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr:
v. 使翘棱；使扭曲变形
n. 弯曲；歪曲
words.ex: The heat will warp the metal.
words.ex_cn: 热量会使金属变形。
words.en: To warp is to bend or twist something out of its natural shape, often as a result of heat or moisture. It can also refer to the state of being bent or twisted.

words.ex: He was wary of strangers who offered free gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他对那些提供免费礼物的陌生人保持谨慎。
words.en: If you are wary of something or someone, you are cautious because you do not know much about them and you believe they may be dangerous or cause problems.

words.ex: A wasp flew into the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 一只黄蜂飞进了厨房。
words.en: A wasp is a flying insect that can sting people and is often yellow and black in color.

words.ex: The river is a natural watercourse.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是一条天然的水道。
words.en: A watercourse is a natural or artificial channel through which water flows.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.tr:
n. 侵蚀；风化
v. 使受风吹雨打；风干；经受住；“weather”的现在分词
words.ex: The rocks are weathering slowly in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 岩石在阳光下缓慢风化。
words.en: The process of wearing away or changing the appearance or texture of something by long exposure to the atmosphere.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.ex: Eating wholesome food helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃有益身心的食物有助于保持健康。
words.en: Conducive to or suggestive of good health and physical well-being.

words.ex: The wick of the candle is burning slowly.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的灯芯正在缓慢燃烧。
words.en: A wick is a piece of string in a candle or lamp that burns to produce light.

words.tr: adj. 任性的；故意的；蓄意的
words.ex: The willful child refused to eat his vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个任性的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you describe actions or attitudes as willful, you are critical of them because they are done or expressed deliberately, especially with the intention of causing harm, or they are stubborn and unreasonable.

words.ex: The willow grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 柳树长在河边。
words.en: A willow is a type of tree with long, thin branches and narrow leaves that grows near water.

words.tr: adj. 小束状的；稀疏的；纤弱的
words.ex: She has wispy hair that floats in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 她有轻盈的头发，在风中飘动。
words.en: Something that is wispy is thin and weak, and often seems to be floating or moving gently.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: The doctor used an x-ray to check his bone.
words.ex_cn: 医生用X光检查了他的骨头。
words.en: An X-ray is a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used in medicine to make images of the inside of the body.

words.ex: She spun wool into yarn to make a sweater.
words.ex_cn: 她把羊毛纺成纱线来织毛衣。
words.en: Yarn is a long, continuous length of interlocked fibers, suitable for use in the production of textiles, sewing, crocheting, knitting, weaving, embroidery, or ropemaking.

words.ex: She adds yeast to make bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 她加入酵母使面包发酵膨胀。
words.en: Yeast is a type of fungus which is used to make bread rise and to make beer and wine.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.ex: I eat yogurt for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早餐吃酸奶。
words.en: Yogurt is a slightly sour thick liquid made from milk with bacteria added to it, often eaten with fruit or used in cooking.

words.ex: He is zealous about helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他热心帮助别人。
words.en: If someone is zealous, they are enthusiastic and eager about something, especially something they believe in very strongly.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr: 短语. 与……大不相同；远非……
words.ex: This new phone is a far cry from the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机和旧手机大不相同。
words.en: phrase. Very different from something.

words.ex: The forest abounds in birds and deer.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里鸟和鹿很多。
words.en: If things abound, or if a place abounds with things, there are very large numbers of them.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 接近某人；与某人接触的机会
words.ex: He doesn't have access to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他无法接触到他的老师。
words.en: The ability or right to use, reach, or obtain something or someone.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使熟悉；使了解；使认识（某人或某事）
words.ex: Let me acquaint you with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 让我让你熟悉新规则。
words.en: To make someone familiar with or knowledgeable about something.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人了解；使熟悉（某事物）
words.ex: He acquainted her with the basic rules of the game.
words.ex_cn: 他让她熟悉了这个游戏的基本规则。
words.en: To make someone familiar with or aware of something.

words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: He needs to adjust to the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应新学校。
words.en: If you adjust to a new situation or get used to it, you change your behaviour or ideas so that you can deal with it successfully.

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To increase or enhance something by adding more to it.

words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.ex: She adorned her room with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用鲜花装饰了房间。
words.en: To adorn something means to make it more beautiful by adding something to it.

words.tr: phrase. 用某物装饰某人；以某物装扮某人
words.ex: The queen was adorned with gold jewelry.
words.ex_cn: 女王被戴上了金制珠宝。
words.en: To decorate or embellish someone or something with ornaments or other decorative items.

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.ex: Her new project is akin to her previous work.
words.ex_cn: 她的新项目与她以前的工作相似。
words.en: If one thing is akin to another, it is similar to it in some way.

words.ex: The children are playing all around the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园周围玩耍。
words.en: In all directions or in every part of a place.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: phrase. 总的来说；整体而言
words.ex: All in all, the trip was fun and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这次旅行又好玩又便宜。
words.en: When you say all in all, you are summarizing a situation or expressing a general opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.tr: 短语. 的确如此；正是如此（用于表示强烈同意）
words.ex: He likes apples, and how about you?
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，你呢？
words.en: Used to ask for more details or to express surprise, often in informal speech.

words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: Aside from John, everyone went to the party.
words.ex_cn: 不包括约翰，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use aside from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 为…辩护；主张；支持（某观点或政策）
words.ex: He argues for better school lunches.
words.ex_cn: 他主张改善学校的午餐。
words.en: To present reasons in support of something; to advocate for.

words.tr: phrase. 安排；为……做准备；促成
words.ex: He will arrange for a taxi to pick him up.
words.ex_cn: 他将安排一辆出租车来接他。
words.en: To make plans or preparations for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 为……安排某事；为……筹划某物
words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for you.
words.ex_cn: 我将为你安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize or make plans for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.ex: As a rule, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 通常，他走路去学校。
words.en: If you say that something happens as a rule, you mean that it usually happens.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.ex: As far as I know, he lives in New York.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他住在纽约。
words.en: According to the information that I have.

words.w: as far as sb. is concerned
words.tr: 短语. 就某人而言；在某人看来
words.uk: əz fɑːr əz ˈsʌmbədi ɪz kənˈsɜːnd
words.us: əz fɑːr əz ˈsʌmbədi ɪz kənˈsɜːrnd
words.ex: As far as I am concerned, homework is important.
words.ex_cn: 就我而言，作业很重要。
words.en: used to give your opinion about something

words.w: as far as sth. is concerned
words.uk: æz fɑː æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz kənˈsɜːnd
words.us: æz fɑːr æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz kənˈsɜːrnd
words.ex: As far as math is concerned, he is very good.
words.ex_cn: 就数学而言，他非常擅长。
words.en: When you are discussing or considering a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.tr: phrase. 至于； 关于；按着；根据
words.ex: I don't know as to when he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。
words.en: Used to indicate what something is about or concerns.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物分配给某人；指派某事物给某人
words.ex: The teacher assigns homework to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task, or to give someone a particular amount of work to do.

words.ex: The teacher assigns him to clean the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师安排他打扫教室。
words.en: To designate someone to perform a specific task or role.

words.ex: I associate with him because we share the same hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 我跟他联系是因为我们有相同的爱好。
words.en: to spend time with someone, especially someone that other people disapprove of

words.tr: phrase. 困惑；不知所措；亏本地
words.ex: He was at a loss when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他不知所措。
words.en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.ex: He can eat one apple at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一次只能吃一个苹果。
words.en: Indicates the number of items or actions that are involved in a single instance or occurrence.

words.ex: I don't like the movie, but at any rate, it was short.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这部电影，但无论如何，它很短。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true or relevant in any case.

words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.tr: phrase. 不时；相隔一定距离（或时间）
words.ex: He checks the machine at intervals.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一段时间检查一下机器。
words.en: If something happens at intervals, it happens occasionally or periodically, with breaks in between.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 由某人做主；由某人随意支配
words.ex: The keys are at your disposal.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙随你使用。
words.en: If you have something at your disposal, you are able to use it whenever you want and for whatever purpose you want.

words.tr: phrase. 以牺牲某事物为代价
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但以牺牲健康为代价。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is achieved by harming them or by using their resources.

words.tr: 介词短语. 在某事物的顶峰时期；在某事最激烈或最成功的时候
words.ex: He was at the height of his career when he won the award.
words.ex_cn: 当他获奖时，正处于他职业生涯的巅峰。
words.en: At the most intense or successful point of something.

words.ex: The boat was at the mercy of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 船听任风暴摆布。
words.en: If one person or thing is at the mercy of another, the first person or thing is in a situation where they cannot prevent themselves being harmed or affected by the second.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.ex: He is late at times.
words.ex_cn: 他有时会迟到。
words.en: on some occasions; occasionally

words.tr: phrase. 随心所欲地；随意地
words.ex: He can leave at will.
words.ex_cn: 他可以随时离开。
words.en: If you can do something at will, you can do it when you want and in the way that you want.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物授予（某人）；把……颁发给……
words.ex: The judge awarded the prize to the best student.
words.ex_cn: 评委把奖颁给了最好的学生。
words.en: To give something, especially a prize or money, to someone as a result of an official decision.

words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没去上学。
words.en: If someone is absent from a place where they are usually found or where they are expected to be, they are not there.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；专心于
words.ex: He is absorbed in reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正专心致志地读书。
words.en: To be so interested in something that you do not notice anything else.

words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.tr: phrase. 适合的；恰当的；相称的
words.ex: This shirt is appropriate for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这个派对。
words.en: Suitable or fitting for a particular person, purpose, or situation.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中；忙于；在起作用
words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在上班。
words.en: To be engaged in the process of doing one's job or task.

words.tr: phrase. 被堵塞的；被积压的（如交通、工作、数据等）
words.ex: My phone is backed up to the cloud.
words.ex_cn: 我的手机数据已备份到云端。
words.en: To be supported, to have a backup made, or to be obstructed or congested.

words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 一定会做某事；注定要做某事
words.ex_cn: 如果他努力学习，他一定会通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 与…紧密相关；与…有密切联系
words.ex: His success is bound up with hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功与努力工作紧密相关。
words.en: To be closely connected or involved with something.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 具有...特色的；为…所特有
words.ex: This noise is characteristic of a broken engine.
words.ex_cn: 这种噪音是发动机坏了的特征。
words.en: To be typical of a particular person or thing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 以…为特征；具有…的特点
words.ex: The city is characterized by narrow streets and old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市以狭窄的街道和古老的建筑为特征。
words.en: To be characterized by something means to have it as a typical or noticeable feature.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.ex: The invention is credited to Thomas Edison.
words.ex_cn: 这项发明归功于托马斯·爱迪生。
words.en: If something is credited to someone, it is believed that they have achieved it or are responsible for it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 因……而受到赞誉；被认为具有（某种成就或贡献）
words.ex: He is credited with inventing the new machine.
words.ex_cn: 他因发明这台新机器而受到赞誉。
words.en: If someone is credited with something, they are officially recognized as having done it or as being responsible for it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…持批评态度的；对…苛求的
words.ex: He is critical of the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他批评新的校规。
words.en: To express disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.tr: phrase. 渴望做某事的；急切想要做某事的
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.ex: He is engaged in writing a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正在写一本书。
words.en: To be involved in a particular activity or task.

words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The lab is equipped with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 实验室配备了新的电脑。
words.en: To be provided with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 对...必要的；非常重要的
words.ex: Water is essential to life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is essential to a particular thing, you mean that it is absolutely necessary for that thing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 被免除，豁免于（某义务、责任或规则等）
words.ex: He is exempt from paying taxes because he is a student.
words.ex_cn: 因为他是一名学生，所以他不用缴税。
words.en: To be exempt from something means to be officially allowed not to do it or not to have to pay it.

words.ex_cn: 孩子应该从小接触好书。
words.en: To be in a situation where one is not protected from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.ex_cn: 他离准备好还很远。
words.en: If something is far from a particular thing or quality, it is not that thing or quality at all.

words.tr: phrase. 不受……影响的；摆脱了……的；无……的
words.ex: He wants to be free of worries.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱烦恼。
words.en: To be without something that is unwanted or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 免于；摆脱（某事物），不受……的困扰
words.ex: He wants to be free from stress.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱压力。
words.en: To not have or be affected by something unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 对...苛刻；对...严厉；对...造成较大压力
words.ex: Don't be hard on him; he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 别对他太苛刻，他已经尽力了。
words.en: To treat someone severely or strictly.

words.tr: phrase. 对…怀有敌意的；表示反对的；不友善的
words.ex: She seemed to be hostile to the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 她似乎对新想法怀有敌意。
words.en: To feel or show unfriendliness, anger, or opposition towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 被打算用于；旨在为……而做或存在
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为初学者准备的。
words.en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned or designed to fulfill that purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 属于…的本土的；原产于
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: To originate or be indigenous to a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 有义务的；不得不；必须（做某事）
words.ex_cn: 我必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because it is a law, a rule, or a duty.

words.tr: phrase. 感到紧张不安；如坐针毡；处于焦虑状态
words.ex: He is on edge before his job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前很紧张。
words.en: If you are on edge, you are nervous and unable to relax.

words.tr: 短语动词. 关系良好，和睦相处
words.ex: I am on good terms with my neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 我和邻居关系很好。
words.en: To have a friendly or amicable relationship with someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在出售；特价销售
words.ex: The shoes are on sale this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周鞋子在打折。
words.en: To be available for purchase at a reduced price.

words.tr: 短语动词. 正在广播；正在播出（指电台、电视等）
words.ex: The radio show is on the air now.
words.ex_cn: 这个广播节目正在播出。
words.en: If a program is on the air, it is being broadcast on radio or television.

words.tr: 短语动词. 上气不接下气；喘不过气来
words.ex: He ran fast and was out of breath.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，喘不过气来。
words.en: To be breathing very quickly and with difficulty, usually after physical exertion.

words.tr: 短语动词. 身体状况不佳；健康状态不好
words.ex: He is out of condition because he stopped exercising.
words.ex_cn: 他因为停止锻炼而体能下降。
words.en: If someone is out of condition, they are not physically fit.

words.tr: phrase. 失灵的；出故障的；不按顺序的；不合规矩的
words.ex: The printer is out of order.
words.ex_cn: 打印机坏了。
words.en: To not be working correctly or to be broken; to behave inappropriately or against the rules.

words.tr: phrase. 不在适当的位置；不合适的；格格不入的
words.ex: His shirt was out of place at the formal party.
words.ex_cn: 他在正式晚会上穿的衬衫很不合适。
words.en: If someone or something is out of place, they are in a situation where they do not belong or fit in.

words.tr: phrase. 走样；身体状况不佳
words.ex: The cake came out of shape when I took it out of the oven.
words.ex_cn: 我把蛋糕从烤箱里拿出来时，它已经走样了。
words.en: If someone is out of shape, they are not in good physical condition because they have not been exercising regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 熟练于……；在……方面精通
words.ex: He is proficient at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: To have or show a high level of skill or ability in a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 精通于……的；在……方面熟练的
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To have or show a high level of skill or ability in a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 被认为是；被当做是
words.ex: He is regarded as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是一位好老师。
words.en: To be considered or thought of in a specified way.

words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.ex: This topic is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这个话题与我们的项目相关。
words.en: To be connected with what is happening or being discussed.

words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: To be easily affected or influenced by something, especially in a way that is not desired.

words.ex: I am sick of cold rain every day.
words.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天下冷雨。
words.en: To be tired of or bored with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: He is subjected to loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都要遭受巨大的噪音。
words.en: To experience something, often something unpleasant or unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 优越于；胜过；不屈服于
words.ex: This phone is superior to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比那部更好。
words.en: To be better or higher in quality, rank, or status than someone or something else.

words.ex: He is supposed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 被……淹没；应接不暇地处理某事，通常指被大量工作或事务压得喘不过气
words.ex: He is swamped with homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都被作业压得喘不过气。
words.en: If you are swamped with things such as work, you have more of them than you can deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 可追溯到；能追溯至
words.ex: The origin of this tradition can be traced to ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源可以追溯到古代。
words.en: To be able to find the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不舒服；生病；身体欠佳
words.ex: He is under the weather today, so he stayed home.
words.ex_cn: 他今天身体不舒服，所以待在家里。
words.en: To feel slightly ill or not as well as usual.

words.tr: phrase. 悬而未决的；不确定的
words.ex: The trip plans are still up in the air.
words.ex_cn: 旅行计划仍然未定。
words.en: If something is up in the air, it is uncertain and often because it has not been decided or agreed on.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯于做某事（后接动名词），表示某人已经适应某种经常性行为或状态
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起上班。
words.en: If you are used to something, you are familiar with it because you have done it or experienced it many times before.

words.ex: He is willing to help his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮朋友做作业。
words.en: If you are willing to do something, you are ready and eager to do it and have no objection to doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: He became aware of his mistake after he checked the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在检查论文后意识到了自己的错误。
words.en: To come to know or realize something.

words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is normal for you.

words.ex: It took her a while to become accustomed to the new routine.
words.ex_cn: 她花了一段时间才适应新的日常安排。
words.en: To become familiar with something and accept it as normal or usual.

words.tr: phrase. v. 习惯于；变得适应
words.ex: He got accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯了早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone so that it seems normal or usual.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.ex: He gets tired of doing the same thing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的事情。
words.en: To become weary or lose patience with something due to overexposure or repetition.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 卷入，参与，牵涉进（某事）
words.ex: He became involved in a school project.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了一个学校项目。
words.en: To become involved in something means to take part in or be connected with it in some way.

words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.ex: Before long, he will finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 不久之后，他就会完成作业。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or is true before long, you mean that it will happen or is true soon.

words.ex: Believe it or not, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 信不信由你，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that may seem surprising or unbelievable.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: He broke through the wall with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手打破了墙壁。
words.en: To break through means to make a way through a barrier or to achieve success in spite of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: He wants to brush up on his math skills before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他想在考试前复习一下他的数学技能。
words.en: To improve one's knowledge of something already learned but partly forgotten.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr: phrase. 大声喊；突发；闯出来
words.ex: He burst out laughing when he heard the joke.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个笑话时突然大笑起来。
words.en: If you burst out doing something, you suddenly start doing it or saying it.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. 不久以后；逐渐地；迟早
words.ex: By and by, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
words.ex_cn: 渐渐地，雨停了，太阳出来了。
words.en: After some time; eventually.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. …得多；尤其；更；到目前为止
words.ex: This is by far the best movie I have seen.
words.ex_cn: 这绝对是我看过的最好的电影。
words.en: By far is used to emphasize that something is the best, worst, biggest, etc., of its kind.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；坚持进行某事
words.ex: He will carry on with his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完晚饭后会继续做作业。
words.en: If you carry on with something, you continue doing it.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: 短语动词. 恢复呼吸；歇一口气；（因惊讶或激动）屏住呼吸
words.ex: He stopped to catch his breath after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后停下来喘口气。
words.en: To pause and rest after physical exertion in order to regain normal breathing.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 补上；赶上（落下的工作、睡眠、消息等）
words.ex: I need to catch up on the latest news.
words.ex_cn: 我需要了解最新的新闻。
words.en: To catch up on something means to do something that you have not had time to do earlier or to learn about recent events.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅迎合素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater to someone or something means to provide them with all the things they need or want.

words.ex: The shop charges for delivery.
words.ex_cn: 商店对送货收费。
words.en: To ask for a payment in exchange for a service or product.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.ex: The car collided with a tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞上了一棵树。
words.en: To collide with something means to crash into it or come into conflict with it.

words.ex: Mix the flour combine with water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 将面粉与水混合做成面团。
words.en: To join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.ex: He came down with the bill after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭后付了账单。
words.en: If you come down with an illness, you catch it or start to suffer from it.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: He comes in every morning at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上8点进来。
words.en: To enter a place, especially a building or room.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进入正题；谈主要问题；切中要点
words.ex: He finally came to the point and told us the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他终于直截了当地告诉我们真相。
words.en: To directly address the main issue or topic without unnecessary details.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He compares his score with his friend's score.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的分数和朋友的分数做比较。
words.en: To examine or look for the difference between two or more things.

words.tr: phrase. 把……比作……；与……相比较（通常用于不同类事物之间的比喻或类比）
words.ex: He compared her smile to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他把她的微笑比作太阳。
words.en: If you compare something to something else, you say that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The company will compensate for the damaged items.
words.ex_cn: 公司将赔偿损坏的物品。
words.en: To compensate for something means to do something to reduce or balance the negative effect of something else.

words.ex: He competes with his brother for the best grades.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟竞争最好的成绩。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.ex: He compresses the file to save space.
words.ex_cn: 他压缩文件以节省空间。
words.en: To compress something means to press it or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 将某人限制在某处；使某人局限于某事物
words.ex: The doctor confined him to bed for three days.
words.ex_cn: 医生让他卧床三天。
words.en: To restrict someone to a particular place or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物限制在某范围内；使局限于
words.ex: Please confine your answer to one page.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的答案限制在一页内。
words.en: To keep something within certain limits or boundaries.

words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: phrase. 与……形成对比；与……对照
words.ex: Her dress contrasts with the white walls.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子与白墙形成对比。
words.en: To show differences when compared.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 冷却下来；平静下来；使冷静
words.ex: The car needs time to cool down after driving.
words.ex_cn: 汽车行驶后需要时间冷却下来。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something become less hot; to become calm after being angry.

words.tr: phrase. v. 冷静下来；使冷却；（使）平息怒气
words.ex: He needs to cool off after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后需要冷静一下。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something less hot; to become calmer or less excited.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. （音乐开始前打拍子）开始计数；把…包括在内
words.ex: The teacher will count in before the choir sings.
words.ex_cn: 合唱团唱歌前，老师会先打拍子计数。
words.en: To include someone in a plan or activity.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 不把…考虑在内；排除；点数后排除
words.ex: Don't count out the weather when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，别把天气因素排除在外。
words.en: If you count out a sum of money, you count the notes or coins as you put them in a pile one by one.

words.ex: The surgeon carefully cut away the tumor.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生小心地切除了肿瘤。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it off.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.ex: He wants to cut down on sugar to be healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入来更健康。
words.en: To reduce the amount or number of something.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；始于（某一时期）
words.ex: These old coins date from the year 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧硬币可以追溯到1800年。
words.en: If something dates from a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.ex: We went back to the hotel after the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会结束后，我们回到了酒店。
words.en: Returning to a previous place or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 日复一日；天天；持续不断地
words.ex: He works day in and day out to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地工作来养家糊口。
words.en: If something happens day in and day out, it happens every day without changing and is often boring.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人某物；使某人失去某物
words.ex: The storm deprives people of power.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨使人们断电。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something, you take it away from them or prevent them from having it.

words.ex: The storm deprived us of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴剥夺了我们的电力。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: 短语动词，意为‘把某人描述为……’，用于表达某人被形容或定义为某种特征或身份
words.ex: They describe her as a kind teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们把她描述成一位和蔼的老师。
words.en: To represent or depict someone or something in a particular way.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: The sound of the bell died away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 铃声渐渐消失了。
words.en: If a sound dies away, it gradually becomes weaker or quieter and then stops completely.

words.tr: phrase. 处理好；处置掉；除掉
words.ex: Please dispose of the trash before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前处理好垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute to each student a book.
words.ex_cn: 老师会给每个学生发一本书。
words.en: To give or deliver something to a number of people.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相处；忍受；处理；与…有关；需要；想做
words.ex: I don't know how to do with him; he is always quiet.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么和他相处；他总是很安静。
words.en: To have a connection or relevance to a particular subject or situation.

words.ex: All our efforts went down the drain when the project was cancelled.
words.ex_cn: 项目被取消后，我们所有的努力都白费了。
words.en: If you say that something is going down the drain, you mean that it is being destroyed or wasted.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐远离；慢慢疏远；（感情、关系等）变得淡漠
words.ex: The small boat started to drift away from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 小船开始从岸边漂走。
words.en: To gradually move away from someone or something, either physically or emotionally.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr: 短语动词。顺便拜访某人
words.ex: I will drop in on my grandma this evening.
words.ex_cn: 今晚我会顺路去看看我奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone informally and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr: phrase. 减少；落下；睡着；让...下车
words.ex: The number of students dropped off last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学生人数减少了。
words.en: If the level, amount, or value of something drops off, it becomes less.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the game because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了决定不参与比赛。
words.en: To leave a school, college, or course of study before you have finished it.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.ex: He endow a library with books.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一图书馆的书。
words.en: If someone is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they naturally have it.

words.tr: phrase. 赋予某物以某种特性；使某物具有某种性质
words.ex: The artist endowed the old statue with new color.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家给那座旧雕像赋予了新的色彩。
words.en: To provide something with a particular quality, feature, or ability.

words.tr: 短语动词. 注册参加；登记入学；加入（课程、学校等）
words.ex: He will enroll in English class next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将报名参加英语课。
words.en: To officially register or join a course, program, or institution.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人有权利做某事或获得某物
words.ex: The ticket entitles you to a free drink.
words.ex_cn: 这张票让你有权免费喝一杯。
words.en: To give someone the right to have or do something.

words.ex: The boy tried to escape from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩试图从着火的房子里逃出来。
words.en: To get away from a place or a situation that is dangerous, unpleasant, or difficult.

words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.ex: I eat ice cream every once in a while.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔吃冰淇淋。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every other day.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一天去一次健身房。
words.en: You use every other to indicate that an action or event happens regularly, with a fixed period of time between each one and the next.

words.tr: phrase. 从…逐步发展而来；由…进化而成
words.ex: The bird evolved from a small reptile.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟是从一种小型爬行动物进化而来的。
words.en: To develop gradually from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr: phrase. 由……逐渐发展而来；从……演化出来
words.ex: The new idea evolved out of a simple discussion.
words.ex_cn: 这个新想法是从一次简单的讨论中发展出来的。
words.en: To develop or come into existence from something else.

words.ex: The small company evolved into a big business.
words.ex_cn: 这家小公司发展成了大企业。
words.en: To develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 被免除（做某事），获准不参加（某活动）
words.ex: He was excused from class because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被允许不去上课。
words.en: To be allowed not to do something that you are normally expected to do.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐消失；慢慢减弱
words.ex: The music fades away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 音乐慢慢消失了。
words.en: To gradually disappear or become less noticeable.

words.ex: The old chair will fall apart if you sit on it.
words.ex_cn: 如果你坐在那把旧椅子上，它就会散架。
words.en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

words.ex: He falls asleep quickly after turning off the light.
words.ex_cn: 他关灯后很快就睡着了。
words.en: To begin to sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 求助于；退到；转而依靠
words.ex: He will fall back on his savings if he loses his job.
words.ex_cn: 如果他失业了，他会依靠自己的储蓄。
words.en: To rely on something or someone for help or support, especially when other options have failed.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.ex: She feels at home in her new apartment.
words.ex_cn: 她在新公寓里感觉像在家一样。
words.en: To feel comfortable and relaxed in a place or with a person, as if you were in your own home.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 代替；顶替（某人工作）
words.ex: Tom will fill in for the teacher when she is sick.
words.ex_cn: 当老师生病时，汤姆会代她的课。
words.en: If you fill in for someone, you do their job or task while they are absent.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.ex: He tried to fill up the hole with sand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用沙子填补那个洞。
words.en: To make something full, or to become full.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: He tries to fit in with his new classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力融入新同学中。
words.en: If you fit in with a group of people, you are accepted by them because you are similar to them or because your behaviour is acceptable to them.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: 为了某人的缘故；看在某人的份上
words.ex: I did it for your sake.
words.ex_cn: 我为了你才这么做的。
words.en: If you do something for someone's sake, you do it in order to help them or make them happy.

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: From now on, I will study every day.
words.ex_cn: 从现在开始，我会每天学习。
words.en: Starting from this moment and continuing into the future.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 从上到下；彻底地；完全地
words.ex: He cleaned the room from top to bottom.
words.ex_cn: 他从上到下把房间打扫了一遍。
words.en: From the highest point to the lowest point; completely or thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 尽快完成（令人不愉快的事情）；了结
words.ex: I just want to get over with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我只想赶紧把会议结束。
words.en: To finish something that is unpleasant or has been delayed, so that you do not have to worry about it anymore.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 尽快完成令人不愉快的事情；把某事尽快了结
words.ex: He wants to get his exam over with.
words.ex_cn: 他想尽快把考试结束掉。
words.en: If you want to get something over with, you want to do it or finish it quickly, especially because it is unpleasant.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭便车；得到帮助或提升
words.ex: I got a lift to school with my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我搭朋友的车去学校。
words.en: To receive a ride in someone else's vehicle, usually without paying.

words.tr: 短语动词. 搭便车；搭车
words.ex: I will get a ride from my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我会搭我哥哥的车。
words.en: To be transported somewhere by someone else in their vehicle.

words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 领会；贿赂；查明；够到
words.ex: I don't know what you are getting at.
words.ex_cn: 我不明白你到底想表达什么。
words.en: If you ask someone what they are getting at, you are asking them to explain what they mean, usually because you think they are being unpleasant or are suggesting something that is untrue.

words.tr: phrase. 重新开始；继续；回去；（事后）答复
words.ex: After lunch, we will get back to work.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后，我们将重新开始工作。
words.en: To return to a place, state, or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.ex: He wants to get out of debt.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱债务。
words.en: To leave a place or situation; to avoid doing something that you do not want to do.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.ex: He is getting used to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他正在习惯早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone, so that it/they no longer seem(s) new, strange, or difficult.

words.tr: 动词短语. 授予……访问权；允许……进入或使用
words.ex: The teacher will give access to the online book.
words.ex_cn: 老师会提供访问在线书籍的权限。
words.en: To provide the means or opportunity to enter or use something.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.ex: She will give birth to a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她下个月要生孩子。
words.en: To bring a baby or young animal into the world by birth.

words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；外出；（症状）消失
words.ex: Go away, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 走开，我需要休息。
words.en: To leave a place or to stop being present in a situation.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a place or situation that you were in before.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a previous place, time, or subject.

words.ex: He goes beyond what the teacher asks.
words.ex_cn: 他做得比老师要求的更多。
words.en: To exceed or surpass a certain limit or expectation.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 停业；倒闭；停止营业
words.ex: The small shop went out of business last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家小店去年倒闭了。
words.en: If a company or business goes out of business, it stops operating, especially because it has failed.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 与…约会；和…一起外出
words.ex: He goes out with his friends on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末和朋友一起出去。
words.en: If you go out with someone, you have a romantic or sexual relationship with them but are not married to them.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；绝对地
words.ex: He is hands down the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里毫无疑问最好的球员。
words.en: Without any doubt; easily.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；逗留；在附近徘徊
words.ex: He hangs around the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any particular purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧握住；坚持下去；保留
words.ex: He hangs on to his old wallet because it reminds him of his dad.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧保留着旧钱包，因为它让他想起爸爸。
words.en: To keep something that you have, especially because it might be useful or valuable in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.ex: I have in mind a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 我心中有一个简单的计划。
words.en: If you have something in mind, you are thinking about it as a possibility or as a thing that you want to do.

words.tr: 短语动词，意思是心里有某个想法、计划或偏好；心中已有打算
words.ex: I have something in mind for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我脑子里有个晚餐的想法。
words.en: To be thinking of a particular plan or idea.

words.ex: This problem has nothing to do with math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学无关。
words.en: If you say that something has nothing to do with a particular subject or situation, you mean that it is not connected with it in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 忙得不可开交；应接不暇
words.ex: She has her hands full with three kids and a full-time job.
words.ex_cn: 她有三个孩子和一份全职工作，忙得不可开交。
words.en: If you have your hands full, you are extremely busy with something.

words.tr: phrase. 忙得不可开交；有大量事情要处理
words.ex: He gets his hands full with two jobs and three kids.
words.ex_cn: 他有两份工作和三个孩子，忙得不可开交。
words.en: To be very busy or have a lot to do.

words.tr: phrase. 远远超过；遥遥领先
words.ex: He is head and shoulders above the others in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上远超其他人。
words.en: If someone or something is head and shoulders above other people or things, they are a lot better than them.

words.tr: phrase. v. 一见如故，相处融洽
words.ex: They hit it off at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他们在聚会上一见如故。
words.en: If two people hit it off, they like each other and become friendly as soon as they meet.

words.tr: phrase. v. 暴跳如雷；大发雷霆；非常生气
words.ex: When he saw the bill, he hit the ceiling.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到账单时，他气炸了。
words.en: To become very angry suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. v. 推迟；阻挡；抑制；保持距离
words.ex: Please hold off until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请等到明天再做。
words.en: To delay doing something, or to prevent something from happening or someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.ex: He holds his breath when he waits for the result.
words.ex_cn: 他等待结果时屏住呼吸。
words.en: If you hold your breath, you make yourself stop breathing for a moment, usually because you are waiting for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 用某事给某人留下深刻印象；以某物打动某人
words.ex: He impressed his teacher with his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的数学能力给老师留下了深刻印象。
words.en: To make someone feel admiration and respect because of something you have done or said.

words.tr: 短语动词. 被深深地印在某物上；被铭记于某物上（常用于抽象意义，如记忆、思想等）
words.ex: The memory was imprinted on his mind.
words.ex_cn: 这个记忆深深印在他的脑海中。
words.en: To be firmly fixed in someone's mind or memory.

words.tr: phrase. 在很大程度上；多半；主要地
words.ex: He succeeded in a large part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他成功在很大程度上是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To a great extent; largely.

words.ex: The books are placed in a row on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地摆成一排放在书架上。
words.en: If something happens several times in a row, it happens that number of times without a break.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.ex: He did an in-depth study of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题进行了深入的研究。
words.en: If you do something in depth, you do it very thoroughly and consider all the details.

words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.ex: The new rule is in effect from Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规定从周一开始生效。
words.en: If a law or rule is in effect, it is operating or being applied.

words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: 状态良好：指物品或人的状态良好，没有损坏或疾病。
words.ex: The car is in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车状况良好。
words.en: If something is in good condition, it is in a good state or quality, especially because it has been well looked after.

words.ex: She cut the apple in half.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果切成两半。
words.en: Into two equal parts.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.ex: The cost is in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 费用与房间的大小成正比。
words.en: If one thing changes or is done in proportion to another, it changes or is done according to how much the other thing changes or is done.

words.ex: They bought apples in quantity.
words.ex_cn: 他们大量购买了苹果。
words.en: In large amounts or numbers; plentifully.

words.tr: phrase. 当季；正当时；处于旺季
words.ex: Apples are in season in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天是当季的。
words.en: If a fruit or vegetable is in season, it is the time of year when it is ready for eating and is widely available.

words.tr: phrase. 健康；在外形上；处于良好状态
words.ex: He runs every day to stay in shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持健康。
words.en: In good physical condition; healthy.

words.ex: In short, he likes pizza.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to introduce a summary of something that has just been said or to give a brief statement of the main points.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: In sum, he did a good job.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他做得很好。
words.en: In sum is used to introduce a summary or conclusion, indicating that what follows is a brief statement of the main points.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 在缺乏…的情况下；在没有…时
words.ex: He left the meeting in the absence of his boss.
words.ex_cn: 在老板不在的情况下，他离开了会议。
words.en: If something happens in the absence of a particular thing, it happens when that thing is not there or when that thing is not available.

words.tr: phrase. 在黑暗中；秘密地；不知道地
words.ex: The children played in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在黑暗中玩耍。
words.en: If you are in the dark about something, you do not know anything about it.

words.tr: phrase. 首先；从一开始；压根
words.ex: I didn't go out in the first place.
words.ex_cn: 我根本就没出去。
words.en: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the first of several reasons, facts, or points that you want to make

words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.ex: He stopped walking in the middle of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他在路中间停了下来。
words.en: If you are in the middle of doing something, you are busy doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之中；在……当中；正当……的时候
words.ex: He is running in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在人群中奔跑。
words.en: If you are in the midst of doing something, you are doing it at the moment.

words.ex: He is in the red because he spent too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他因为花太多钱而亏钱了。
words.en: If someone is in the red, they owe money or have spent more than they have earned.

words.ex: He arrived in time for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶上了公交车。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, after a lot of time has passed.

words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.tr: phrase. 从某事物推断出某事物；由…推知；根据…得出结论
words.ex: He inferred the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: To conclude or deduce something from evidence and reasoning rather than from explicit statements.

words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.tr: phrase. v. 坚持；坚决要求；执意要
words.ex: He insists upon finishing his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持要在吃晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: Don't interfere with my work.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的工作。
words.en: To interfere with something means to prevent it from happening or developing as it should, often by causing a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: He wants to invest in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他想投资一家小企业。
words.en: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or achieve a result.

words.tr: phrase. 与…一致；与…相符；与…和谐
words.ex: His story does not jibe with the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的说法与事实不符。
words.en: To be in agreement with; to match or correspond to something.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；正是；大约；马上
words.ex: I have just about finished my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我差不多快写完作业了。
words.en: Almost; very nearly.

words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 竭尽全力；拼命努力；累坏自己；随意去做（表示不介意的客气话）
words.ex: He knocked himself out trying to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他拼命努力完成这个项目，累坏了。
words.en: To exert oneself to the utmost; to make a great effort.

words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 不管；不理会；更不用说
words.ex: Leave him alone; he wants to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 别管他，他想安静一下。
words.en: To not disturb or bother someone; to allow someone to be by themselves.

words.ex: He leaves for work at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点出发去上班。
words.en: To depart from a place to go to another.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.ex: The candles light up the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛点亮了房间。
words.en: To make something bright or to start to burn.

words.tr: verb phrase. 被……散落得到处都是；布满……（通常指杂乱的东西）
words.ex: The room was littered with empty soda cans and pizza boxes.
words.ex_cn: 房间里到处都是空汽水罐和披萨盒。
words.en: If something is littered with things, it contains many examples of it, often in a way that is not organized or tidy.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.ex: I look up to my teacher because she is kind and smart.
words.ex_cn: 我尊敬我的老师，因为她善良又聪明。
words.en: If you look up to someone, you respect and admire them.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻一些体重；减肥
words.ex: She decided to lose some weight after her doctor's advice.
words.ex_cn: 在医生的建议下，她决定减肥。
words.en: To reduce one's body weight intentionally, usually by dieting or exercising.

words.tr: phrase. 失去对……的线索；与……失去联系；忘记；未能跟踪
words.ex: He lost track of time while playing games.
words.ex_cn: 他玩游戏时忘记了时间。
words.en: To fail to keep oneself informed about someone or something; to lose contact with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出观点；表明看法；特意做某事以强调
words.ex: He made a point to finish his homework early.
words.ex_cn: 他特意早点完成作业。
words.en: To make a point means to express an idea or opinion clearly and directly, often in a way that is intended to persuade others or to emphasize the importance of something.

words.w: make a point of doing sth.
words.tr: phrase. 特意做某事；认为做某事很重要；总是坚持做某事
words.uk: meɪk ə pɔɪnt əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə pɔɪnt əv ˈduɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She made a point of thanking everyone who helped her.
words.ex_cn: 她特意感谢了每一个帮助过她的人。
words.en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate and obvious way, often because you think it is important.

words.ex: We don't have enough food, so we will make do with what we have.
words.ex_cn: 我们没有足够的食物，所以只能将就着用现有的。
words.en: If you make do with something, you use or have it instead of something else that you do not have, although it is not as good.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He makes his living by selling vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他靠在市场卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn the money one needs to live.

words.ex: He earns his living by fixing cars.
words.ex_cn: 他靠修车谋生。
