words.en: To earn one's living means to make enough money to support oneself and one's family, typically through work.

words.tr: phrase. 详细规划；制定；筹划；在地图上标出路线
words.ex: He will map out the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会规划出这个计划。
words.en: To plan or arrange something in detail.

words.ex: This phone meets my needs.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机满足我的需求。
words.en: To satisfy or fulfill someone's requirements or desires.

words.tr: phrase. 满足需求；符合需要
words.ex: The new product was designed to meet the needs of the modern consumer.
words.ex_cn: 这款新产品是为满足现代消费者的需求而设计的。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy the requirements or desires of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 不妨；倒不如；还是…为好
words.ex: Since we're already here, we might as well stay for the show.
words.ex_cn: 既然我们已经在这里了，不妨留下来看表演。
words.en: Used to suggest that something should be done or accepted because there is no good reason not to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 尤其；最重要的是；最特别的是
words.ex: Most of all, I want to thank my family for their support.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，我要感谢我的家人的支持。
words.en: Above all; especially.

words.tr: phrase. 缩小范围；精简；使变窄
words.ex: He tried to narrow down the list of options.
words.ex_cn: 他试图缩小选项的范围。
words.en: To reduce the number of possibilities or choices.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr:
adj. 即时的；未经准备的；唐突无礼的
adv. 即时地；未经思索地；随便地
words.ex: He gave an offhand answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个即时的回答。
words.en: If you say something offhand, you say it without checking the details or facts of it beforehand.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 偏离目标的；不准确的；离题的；错误的
words.ex: His predictions were off the mark.
words.ex_cn: 他的预测不准确。
words.en: If something is off the mark, it is incorrect or inaccurate.

words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为基础；根据；按照
words.ex: He made a decision on the basis of the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做出了决定。
words.en: On the basis of means using something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底了结地；一劳永逸地
words.ex: He solved the problem once and for all.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底解决了这个问题。
words.en: If something is done once and for all, it is done completely and finally.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or current; obsolete.

words.ex: He got over and above what he needed.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了比需要的更多的东西。
words.en: In addition to; besides.

words.ex: He was late owing to the bus delay.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

words.ex: My grandfather passed down his old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父把他的旧手表传给了我。
words.en: To transmit or hand down from one generation to another.

words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially after receiving it or using it; to continue moving forward; to die.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.ex: He points to the door when he wants to leave.
words.ex_cn: 当他想离开时，他指向门。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something as being likely or true.

words.ex: I prefer to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢走路去学校。
words.en: If you prefer to do something, you like it more than another thing and would choose it if you could.

words.tr: phrase. 为…保存某物；保留某物供…使用
words.ex: We should preserve some food for tomorrow's meal.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该为明天的饭保留一些食物。
words.en: To keep something safe or in good condition for a specific purpose or future use.

words.tr: phrase. 驶离；离开；脱身；拉开距离
words.ex: The car started to pull away from the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 汽车开始从公交站开走了。
words.en: To move away or depart, especially in a vehicle; to create distance between oneself and someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 努力争取；强烈要求；奋力推进
words.ex: They will push for a better deal.
words.ex_cn: 他们将争取更好的交易。
words.en: To make a determined effort to achieve or obtain something, often in the face of opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；付诸实行
words.ex: The new rules will be put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一实施。
words.en: To cause something to start to apply or operate.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.tr: phrase. 喧闹狂欢；大声抗议；把屋顶掀翻（形容极度兴奋或愤怒）
words.ex: The crowd will raise the roof when the band plays their favorite song.
words.ex_cn: 当乐队演奏他们最爱的歌时，观众会欢呼雀跃。
words.en: To make a lot of noise, especially by cheering or shouting, or to cause a lot of excitement or enthusiasm.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.tr: phrase. 注册；登记；报名参加（课程、活动等）
words.ex: Students need to register for their courses before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要在截止日期前注册他们的课程。
words.en: To officially sign up or enroll in a course, event, or activity.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人竞选……；与某人竞争……职位
words.ex: He decided to run against the incumbent for the presidency.
words.ex_cn: 他决定与现任总统竞选总统职位。
words.en: To compete against someone in an election for a particular position.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 省省力气；别白费口舌（指说话无用，不如保持沉默）
words.ex: He won't listen, so save your breath.
words.ex_cn: 他不会听的，所以别白费口舌了。
words.en: To save one's breath means to avoid wasting time or effort in trying to convince someone of something when it is unlikely that they will change their opinion or decision.

words.ex: He saves up money to buy a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱买一辆自行车。
words.en: To gradually collect money by saving it, especially for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.

words.ex: This room can serve as a meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间可以充当会议室。
words.en: To function or be used as something.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: They set on fire the old tree.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那棵老树点着了。
words.en: To cause something to start burning.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.ex: He showed me around the school.
words.ex_cn: 他带我参观了学校。
words.en: to guide someone on a tour of a place, making them familiar with it

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.ex: I forgot to call her—it slipped my mind.
words.ex_cn: 我忘了给她打电话——我给忘了。
words.en: If something slips your mind, you forget it.

words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 跳起来；发生；迅速发展
words.ex: The ball springs up when it hits the ground.
words.ex_cn: 球碰到地面时跳起来。
words.en: To appear or develop quickly and/or suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；捍卫；为…挺身而出
words.ex: He will stand up for his friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对他的朋友刻薄时，他会为朋友挺身而出。
words.en: To support or defend someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；出发；起初从事（某事）
words.ex: He starts out as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始是一名老师。
words.en: To begin a journey or a process.

words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.ex: I will stick with this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我会坚持这个计划。
words.en: To continue to support or use something, even though it may be difficult or you may want to change to something else.

words.ex: He tried to stir up trouble at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在会议上挑起麻烦。
words.en: To cause trouble or strong feelings; to provoke or incite.

words.ex: I'll stop by your office later.
words.ex_cn: 我稍后会顺便去你办公室拜访。
words.en: To visit someone briefly, often while on the way to another place.

words.tr: phrase. 挺直身体；整理；收拾整齐；改过自新
words.ex: He straightened up when the teacher entered the room.
words.ex_cn: 老师进房间时，他挺直了身体。
words.en: To make something tidy or to improve one's behavior or posture.

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.ex: He strives for success every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在努力追求成功。
words.en: To try very hard to achieve something.

words.ex: She decided to submit to the committee's decision.
words.ex_cn: 她决定服从委员会的决定。
words.en: To accept or yield to the authority or control of someone or something.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.ex: He decided to take a chance and apply for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险申请这份工作。
words.en: To do something that involves risk or uncertainty, often with the hope of success.

words.tr: phrase. 改期再约；婉拒当前邀请但表示将来愿意接受
words.ex: I can't make it to the party tonight, but can I take a rain check?
words.ex_cn: 我今晚不能参加派对，但我能改天去吗？
words.en: If you say that you will take a rain check on an offer or suggestion, you mean that you will decline it now but may accept it at a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到某事；顾及某事
words.ex: When making decisions, it's important to take account of all the factors involved.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定时，重要的是要考虑到所有相关的因素。
words.en: To consider or pay attention to something when making a decision or judgment.

words.ex: Please take the weather into account when you plan the trip.
words.ex_cn: 计划旅行时请考虑天气因素。
words.en: To consider something when making a decision or judgment.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: phrase. 就位；取代某人的位置；担任某人的职位
words.ex: The actor took his place on stage.
words.ex_cn: 演员上了舞台就位。
words.en: To replace someone in a particular role or position.

words.tr: phrase. 就位；占据自己的位置；担任某个职位或角色
words.ex: He will take his position at the company next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他下周一将到公司就职。
words.en: To assume a particular place or role, especially in a formal or official context.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. 请假；抽出时间休息；暂时离开工作或职责
words.ex: He will take time off to visit his family.
words.ex_cn: 他将请假去探望家人。
words.en: To take time off means to take a break from work or other duties, often for rest or to deal with personal matters.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. v.与……合作：与某人或某物合作完成某项任务或达成某个目标。
words.ex: He teams with his brother to fix the car.
words.ex_cn: 他和他哥哥一起修车。
words.en: To collaborate or work together with someone on a project or task.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；分辨（常用于指区分两个或多个相似的人或物）
words.ex: I can't tell the twins apart.
words.ex_cn: 我分不清这对双胞胎。
words.en: To recognize or understand the difference between two or more things or people.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: 习语. 越多越热闹；人越多越高兴
words.ex: We're having a party, and the more the merrier!
words.ex_cn: 我们正在开派对，越多越好！
words.en: Used to say that a situation will be more enjoyable if a lot of people are there.

words.tr: 短语。表示某人或某物正在离开、消失或被用掉；常带有惋惜、无奈或感叹的语气，如‘（某物）没了’或‘（某人）走了’
words.ex: There goes the last bus.
words.ex_cn: 最后一班公交车开走了。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is happening or someone is leaving.

words.tr: phrase. 扔掉某物；丢弃某物；赶走某人
words.ex: Don't forget to throw out the garbage before you leave.
words.ex_cn: v. 离开前别忘了扔垃圾。
words.en: To discard something as unwanted; to suggest or propose something, especially casually or as a possibility.

words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 扎牢；妥善解决；密切联系；占用；合伙；停泊
words.ex: He will tie up the loose rope.
words.ex_cn: 他会把松开的绳子系好。
words.en: To tie up means to fasten or secure something with a cord, rope, or the like. It can also mean to occupy or engage someone or something completely, leaving no time or resources for other activities.

words.ex: To date, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 到此为止，还没有人解决这个问题。
words.en: Up to the present time.

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 辗转反侧；翻来覆去（难以入睡）
words.ex: I toss and turn every night because I can't sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我每晚辗转反侧，因为我睡不着。
words.en: If you toss and turn, you keep moving around in bed and cannot sleep, usually because you are worried or uncomfortable.

words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up to date.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己的知识保持最新。
words.en: If something is up to date, it is the newest thing of its kind.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.ex: The picture is upside down.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片是倒着的。
words.en: If something is upside down, it is in a position in which the part that is usually at the bottom is at the top.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: The new technology will usher in a better future.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将开启一个更美好的未来。
words.en: To usher in something means to be at the start of a new period, especially one that involves important changes or improvements.

words.tr: phrase. 投票支持；选举（某人）
words.ex: I will vote for her in the election.
words.ex_cn: 我将在选举中投她一票。
words.en: To express one's choice or preference in a decision-making process, especially in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 投票以决定做某事；表决通过做某事
words.ex: They vote to choose the class president.
words.ex_cn: 他们投票选举班长。
words.en: To decide or express a preference for a particular option or candidate through a formal vote.

words.tr: phrase. 小心行事；注意自己的言行；提防危险
words.ex: Be careful and watch your step on the icy path.
words.ex_cn: 在结冰的小路上要小心，注意脚下。
words.en: To be careful about what one does or says, especially in order to avoid trouble or danger.

words.ex: The shoes show wear and tear after walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天走路后，鞋子出现了磨损。
words.en: The damage or deterioration that naturally and inevitably occurs as a result of normal use or aging.

words.ex: The wind wears away the rock slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢地磨损了石头。
words.en: To erode or diminish gradually through friction, use, or exposure.

words.tr: phrase. 用坏；穿破；（使）筋疲力尽；耗尽
words.ex: He wore out his shoes after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步，把鞋子磨坏了。
words.en: To wear out means to make something old and damaged because it has been used a lot, or to make someone extremely tired.

words.tr: phrase. 给（钟表等）上发条；使紧张；结束；最终导致
words.ex: He will wind up the clock every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都会给钟上发条。
words.en: To bring something to an end; to coil or twist something; to make someone nervous or excited.

words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.ex: We need to decide with respect to the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到天气来做出决定。
words.en: Regarding or concerning something.

words.tr: phrase. 随着……的到来；随着……的出现
words.ex: With the advent of smartphones, people use maps more often.
words.ex_cn: 随着智能手机的出现，人们更经常使用地图。
words.en: Indicates the time when something new starts or becomes available.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的帮助下；借助于
words.ex: He was able to solve the problem with the aid of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 在老师的帮助下，他能够解决这个问题。
words.en: Using something or someone to help achieve a goal or complete a task.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with the exception of Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，所有人都通过了考试。
words.en: You use 'with the exception of' to introduce a thing or person that is not included in a general statement that you are making.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 逐步发展；激发（情绪）；费力完成；锻炼身体
words.ex: He worked up a plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他逐步制定出一个存钱的计划。
words.en: To develop or increase something gradually, or to make someone feel an emotion strongly.

words.tr: phrase. 包裹；圆满完成；（使）穿得暖和
words.ex: She will wrap up the gift with colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她会用彩纸把礼物包起来。
words.en: To finish or complete something; to cover or enclose something in paper or soft material.

words.tr: （口语）我当然知道；你这话我深有同感（表示赞同或强调自己早已知晓）
words.ex: A: It's really hot today. B: You are telling me.
words.ex_cn: A: 今天真热。B: 这还用你说。
words.en: An expression used to show strong agreement, implying that what someone has said is obvious or already known.

words.tr: phrase. 当然！的确如此！（表示强烈同意或肯定）
words.ex: A: Can you help me with this? B: You bet!
words.ex_cn: A: 你能帮我这个忙吗？ B: 当然可以！
words.en: An informal expression of certainty, agreement, or willingness.

words.tr: phrase. （表示强烈同意）你说得太对了！
words.ex: A: This movie is fantastic! B: You can say that again!
words.ex_cn: A: 这部电影太棒了！B: 说得对极了！
words.en: Used to express strong agreement with what someone has said.

words.tr: 感叹语. （表示强烈赞同）你说得太对了！
words.ex: A: This movie is really boring. B: You said it!
words.ex_cn: A: 这部电影真的很无聊。B: 你说得对！
words.en: An informal phrase used to express strong agreement, meaning 'I completely agree' or 'That's exactly right'.

words.w: your guess is as good as mine.
words.tr: phrase. 你的猜测和我一样毫无把握；我也不知道
words.uk: jɔː ɡes ɪz æz ɡʊd æz maɪn
words.us: jʊr ɡɛs ɪz æz ɡʊd æz maɪn
words.ex: When asked about the future, he simply said, 'Your guess is as good as mine.'
words.ex_cn: 当被问及未来时，他只是说：‘我也说不准。’
words.en: Used to say that you do not know the answer to a question any better than the person asking.
